title: Jengo la maduka kama piramidi ya Misri, na nikakuta Jollibee ndani
label: Jengo la piramidi

text.In Sunway, Malaysia, there is a pyramid-: Huko Sunway, Malaysia, kuna jengo la maduka lenye umbo la piramidi linaloitwa "Sunway Pyramid."
text.When I passed by it in a taxi, I went, \: Nilipopita karibu nalo kwa teksi, nilijiuliza, ‘Hiki ni nini? Hili ni jengo gani?’
text.There was a sphinx and more, and it look: Kulikuwa na sanamu ya sphinx na mengine, na kwa nje lilionekana la kuvutia pia.
text.It is a shopping mall, but there is an i: Ni jengo la maduka, lakini ndani kuna uwanja wa kuteleza kwenye barafu.
text.⛸ An ice rink inside the mall: ⛸ Uwanja wa barafu ndani ya jengo la maduka
Vyovyote vile, jengo hili la piramidi ni kubwa sana.
text.It was so big that walking from one end: Lilikuwa kubwa kiasi kwamba nilipokuwa nikitembea kutoka upande mmoja hadi mwingine nilijiuliza, ‘Huu ni uwanja wa ndege?’
text.Inside the pyramid mall, I found a shop: Ndani ya jengo hilo la piramidi nilipata duka linaloitwa Jollibee.
text.The reason I took a photo is that it mad: Nilipiga picha kwa sababu lilinikumbusha mambo ya zamani.
text.When I lived in the Philippines, this sh: Nilipoishi Ufilipino, duka hili la Jollibee lilikuwa maarufu sana huko.
text.How popular? The Philippines is probably: Maarufu kiasi gani? Huenda Ufilipino ndiyo nchi pekee ambako Jollibee ni maarufu zaidi kuliko McDonald's.
text.In the Philippines, you see Jollibee mor: Ufilipino unaona Jollibee mara nyingi zaidi kuliko McDonald's.
text.In Japan, you do not see Jollibee. You s: Japani huoni Jollibee, lakini McDonald's unaiona.
text.I saw Jollibee, which you do not see in: Nilipoiona Jollibee ambayo haipatikani Japani, nilisema, ‘Lo, imenikumbusha zamani!’ kisha nikapiga picha bila kufikiri.
text.Cheese chicken at K Fry, and a hint that: Kuku wa jibini wa K Fry, na ishara kwamba chakula cha nchi fulani ni kizuri
